pages.title: A rainy Friday · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in a cozy apartment in Seattle. Rain taps on the window. Cleo and Raul sit on the sofa with a phone. Neither of them wants to cook. Cleo opens a food app and shows the menu. They choose together.
“I’m hungry. Let’s get pizza. Which size?” says Cleo. “Let’s get a large one. We are three.” says Raul. “Good idea. What toppings do you want?” says Cleo.
